# Apidog

> > Apidog is an all-in-one API development platform offering design-first workflows, testing, mocking, documentation, and debugging tools with native support for OpenAPI, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSocket protocols.

Apidog provides a comprehensive suite of API lifecycle management tools, positioning itself as a Postman alternative with enhanced collaboration features, visual OpenAPI design capabilities, and support for multiple API protocols including HTTP, SOAP, SSE, and CI/CD integration.

## Key Topics

- API Design
- API Testing
- API Documentation
- API Mocking
- OpenAPI Specification
- Design-First Development
- RESTful APIs
- Postman Alternative
- JSON Schema
- API Authorization
- GraphQL
- gRPC
- WebSocket
- CI/CD Integration
- Developer Collaboration

## API Testing & Debugging

- [Mock REQUEST Bodies to Accelerate API Debugging](https://apidog.com/blog/mock-request-bodies-automatically-to-accelerate-api-debugging): Guide to auto-generating mock request bodies for faster API debugging
- [Mocking APIs with Complexed Data in Minutes](https://apidog.com/blog/how-to-mock-apis): Guide to mocking complex APIs with enums, arrays, and schemas in Apidog
- [Visualizing Responses - Apidog Docs](https://apidog.com/help/script/script-example/visualizing-responses): Apidog guide to visualizing API responses using Handlebars and HTML
- [Import cURL - Apidog Docs](https://apidog.com/help/import/import-curl): Apidog documentation for importing cURL commands from DevTools and proxies
- [Top 8 JavaScript Debugging Tools for Front-End Development](https://apidog.com/blog/best-javascript-debugging-tools): Review of 8 JavaScript debugging tools including VS Code and Chrome DevTools
